visibleTestCases.title: Cluster Node Info and Self RPC
visibleTestCases.erlangCall: begin Info = cluster_pubsub_pg:cluster_node_info(), {ok, Alive} = cluster_pubsub_pg:safe_remote_call(node(), erlang, is_alive, []), {maps:get(alive, Info), Alive} end
visibleTestCases.explanation: Verifies node introspection and local RPC execution.

visibleTestCases.title: Decentralized pg Topic Join and Publish
visibleTestCases.erlangCall: begin Self = self(), ok = cluster_pubsub_pg:join_topic(<<"alerts">>, Self), {published, 1} = cluster_pubsub_pg:publish_to_topic(<<"alerts">>, <<"cluster_overload">>), Msg = receive {pubsub, <<"alerts">>, M} -> M after 100 -> timeout end, ok = cluster_pubsub_pg:leave_topic(<<"alerts">>, Self), Msg end
visibleTestCases.explanation: Tests joining a topic, publishing, receiving the message, and leaving.
